text: ヘラクロスの　おおきさを　はかって　くれる　おねえさんが　はやしの　ちかくに　いるんだよ

structure.jp: ヘラクロスの　おおきさを　はかって　くれる
structure.en: who will measure your Heracross's size for you

structure.jp: はやしの　ちかくに　いるんだよ
structure.en: is near the forest, you know

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: はかって　くれる　おねえさん
patterns.explanation: A short sentence placed in front of a thing word describes it. はかって　くれる　おねえさん = 'a lady who measures it for you'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: くれる after a て verb says someone does it as a favour to you. はかって　くれる = 'measures it for you'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken のだ, used when filling someone in on something. いるんだよ = 'there is one, you know'.
